title: The Deubiquitinase OTUD5 regulates cardiac hypertrophy by stabilizing TNF receptor associated factor 2.
authors: Zhao, Wei; Li, Qilin; Chen, Huiwen; Jiang, Rongli; Ge, Gaoyuan
journal: Journal of molecular and cellular cardiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究去泛素化酶OTUD5通过稳定TRAF2调控心肌肥厚，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作与信号通路研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pathological cardiac hypertrophy acts as a major pathological contributor to heart failure, profoundly influencing patient outcomes. Deubiquitinating enzymes, which are critical for maintaining protein homeostasis, are increasingly recognized as essential regulators in cardiac hypertrophy and dysfunction. This study aimed to investigate the role of a specific deubiquitinase, Ovarian tumor domain-containing protein 5 (OTUD5), in cardiac hypertrophy and elucidate its functional mechanisms. METHODS: A pressure overload-induced cardiac hypertrophy model was created in mice using transverse aortic constriction (TAC) surgery. Additionally, phenylephrine (PE) was employed to induce hypertrophic responses in cultured cardiomyocytes. Cardiac function and structural changes were assessed through echocardiography and histological analysis. To uncover the underlying mechanisms, techniques such as molecular docking, immunofluorescence co-localization, co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP), and in vivo ubiquitination assays were utilized. RESULTS: OTUD5 exhibited elevated expression in both human and mouse samples with hypertrophy-associated heart failure (HF). Silencing OTUD5 diminished cardiomyocyte enlargement in both cellular and TAC-induced mouse models, whereas its overexpression exacerbated cardiac hypertrophy. Mechanically, OTUD5 physically interacted with TNF receptor-associated factor 2 (TRAF2) and bolstered its stability by cleaving K48-linked polyubiquitin chains. Furthermore, OTUD5 activates the NF-kappaB and AKT/GSK3beta signaling pathways in TRAF2-dependent manner. Importantly, cardiomyocyte-specific knockdown of TRAF2 in the heart significantly attenuated OTUD5's hypertrophic-promoting effects in vivo. CONCLUSIONS: These findings indicate that OTUD5 positively modulates cardiac hypertrophy by stabilizing TRAF2 and promote activation of NF-kappaB and AKT/GSK3beta signaling, positioning OTUD5 as a potential therapeutic target for cardiac hypertrophy.
abstract_zh: 背景：病理性心脏肥厚是心力衰竭的主要病理因素，深刻影响患者预后。去泛素化酶对维持蛋白质稳态至关重要，日益被认为是心脏肥厚和功能障碍的关键调节因子。本研究旨在探讨特异性去泛素化酶——卵巢肿瘤结构域蛋白5（OTUD5）在心脏肥厚中的作用，并阐明其功能机制。方法：通过横向主动脉缩窄（TAC）手术在小鼠中建立压力超负荷诱导的心脏肥厚模型。此外，使用苯肾上腺素（PE）诱导培养心肌细胞中的肥厚反应。通过超声心动图和组织学分析评估心脏功能和结构变化。为揭示潜在机制，采用了分子对接、免疫荧光共定位、共免疫沉淀（co-IP）和体内泛素化检测等技术。结果：在人类和小鼠肥厚相关心力衰竭（HF）样本中，OTUD5表达均升高。沉默OTUD5在细胞和TAC诱导的小鼠模型中减弱了心肌细胞增大，而其过表达则加剧了心脏肥厚。机制上，OTUD5与肿瘤坏死因子受体相关因子2（TRAF2）发生物理相互作用，并通过切割K48连接的多聚泛素链增强其稳定性。此外，OTUD5以TRAF2依赖性方式激活NF-kappaB和AKT/GSK3beta信号通路。重要的是，心脏中心肌细胞特异性敲低TRAF2显著减弱了OTUD5在体内的促肥厚效应。结论：这些发现表明，OTUD5通过稳定TRAF2并促进NF-kappaB和AKT/GSK3beta信号激活，正向调节心脏肥厚，将OTUD5定位为心脏肥厚的潜在治疗靶点。
